items.title: One Coach button
items.body: Tap the talking monkey at the top to ask Coach, hold to talk.

items.title: Social posts open up
items.body: Tap a Social post to see the full workout, then make it yours: today, any day this week or My workouts.

items.title: Share your wins as stories
items.body: PRs, levels, badges, programmes and meals become stories in 3 looks, with your photo. Don't want prompts? Your profile → Share prompts.

items.title: Clearer Train buttons
items.body: Custom gym session shows your gym, and one Sport button logs, tracks live or plans.

items.title: How it works
items.body: Where every number comes from: XP, plan, loads, readiness, zones, Fuel. Your own numbers, the rule and sources. Something off? Tell us from the page.

items.title: Customise from the top
items.body: The workout page's customise button now sits in the top bar.
